<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully retrieved the calendars for both Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. The next step is to identify the times they are both free and communicate this to Brad.

First, I need to parse the busy times for both partners and determine their common free slots. A 30-minute meeting can start on the hour or at the half-hour mark. The working hours are 9:00 to 17:00.

**Priya Raman's Busy Times:**
- Mon: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
- Tue: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30
- Wed: 09:00-12:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00
- Thu: 09:30-10:00, 10:30-17:00
- Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-17:00

**Marcus Hale's Busy Times:**
- Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00
- Tue: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-16:30
- Wed: 09:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00
- Thu: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-12:00, 12:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00
- Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00

Now I'll find the common free slots. A slot is free if neither person is busy. For a 30-minute meeting starting at time `T`, the interval `[T, T+30mins]` must be free for both.

**Monday:**
- Priya free: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
- Marcus free: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30
- Common free slots: 09:00, 09:30

**Tuesday:**
- Priya free: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
- Marcus free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Common free slots: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30. Oh wait, Marcus is free from 13:00-14:00, so 13:00 and 13:30 are valid start times. Priya is also free 13:00-14:00. So Tuesday 13:00 and 13:30 work. Let me re-check my initial manual calculation.
Priya's busy: Tue 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30. So Priya is free 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00.
Marcus' busy: Tue 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-16:30. So Marcus is free 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00.
Common free: 13:00-14:00 (slots 13:00, 13:30), 16:30-17:00 (slot 16:30). My initial manual check was wrong. There are common slots on Tuesday.

Let me be more systematic.
I will list available 30-min start times for each partner.
**Priya:**
Mon: 9:00, 9:30, 13:00, 13:30
Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
Wed: 9:00 (no, busy), 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 9:00, 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

**Marcus:**
Mon: 9:00, 9:30, 11:00, 15:00
Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 9:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 12:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 14:30

**Common Slots:**
Mon: 9:00, 9:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

This is a much better list. I will post this to the workspace for Brad. This gives him a clear set of options to check against his partners' calendars.
